title: DiamondFire Modpack
description: A must have modpack for mcdiamondfire.com (with ease and simplicity)
body:
# MCDiamondfire Modpack

## About

[MCDiamondfire](https://mcdiamondfire.com/) is a minecraft server mainly about coding blocks and making mini-games in it.

_It could also be a game engine since it has alot of functionality,_ however, sometimes its not fast enough, and sometimes you need some mods to make the coding process easier and cooler, **and thats where my modpack comes in.**

My modpack supports:
- A better color picker,
- [WeCode](https://modrinth.com/mod/wecode) and [a very cool recode alternative](https://github.com/DFOnline/codeclient),
- Ease of coding and Freecam support,
- A diamondfire rich presence for discord,
- (Required lib: [Flint](https://modrinth.com/mod/flint)),
- And much more!!
  
(The WeCode version in this modpack was modified and compiled and is safe, its basically to add a couple features to the existing mod to make it cooler and easier to use)

## FAQ
Q1: What is recode and why is it discontinued?

A: [Recode](https://github.com/homchom/recode) *was* a mod like WeCode or CodeClient that made coding on DF (Diamondfire) easier, but it got discontinued due to development and compatibility problems *i suppose*. *Btw, Recode was a successor to [CodeUtilities V2.0](https://codeutilities.github.io/) which was also discontinued*

Q2: Why would i have it?

A: The overall modpack is very cool! You can check the features list if you're paranoid, but overall, it is awesome for mcdiamondfire.
